titolo: Ancient Structures Scientists Still Can't Explain

scene.testo: Some ancient structures should not exist at all.
Yet they have stood for thousands of years.
The Great Pyramid stayed the tallest structure for nearly 3,800 years.
Its builders finished it around 2560 BC.
Its blocks are fitted with astonishing precision.
In Peru, Inca walls lock together without any mortar.
They have survived centuries of powerful earthquakes.
At Stonehenge, huge stones were hauled across Britain.
Some of them came from Wales, about 150 miles away.
How did Neolithic people move them without metal tools?
In Turkey, Göbekli Tepe is about eleven thousand years old.
Its carved stone pillars stand taller than a grown man.
That is thousands of years older than Stonehenge.
Its builders had no writing and no metal tools.
Scientists still debate why they built it.
At Baalbek in Lebanon, Roman builders left colossal stones.
Some weigh hundreds of tons, and were cut from a quarry.
But that's not the strangest part.
